# Now let me search for each song to get the song IDs.
old_song_ids = set()
for title, artist in old_song_queries.items():
    # Search by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    if results:
        for song in results:
            # Check if title matches and artist matches
            if song["title"].lower() == title.lower():
                # Check if any artist matches
                song_artists = [a["name"].lower() for a in song["artists"]]
                expected_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in artist.split(",")]
                if any(ea in song_artists for ea in expected_artists):
                    old_song_ids.add(song["song_id"])
                    print(f"Found: {title} by {artist} -> ID: {song['song_id']}")
                    break
